dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped structures along the mid-flank and posterior-dorsal region. Lower-central annuli exhibit thin, high-intensity (light) perimeters surrounding low-intensity (dark) interior cores. Several smaller annuli in the posterior region show a inverse transition with high-intensity interior centroids surrounded by darker rings.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid pixel blobs; however, a localized high concentration of high-intensity pixels forms a complex, multi-segment branching linear feature in the anterior-dorsal quadrant. Small, isolated high-intensity pixel clusters are scattered in the posterior-most region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent lower-central annuli form a nearly equilateral triangle. A broader geometric relationship exists between the apex of the anterior branching feature and the centroids of the posterior-most annular cluster, forming a longitudinal vector across the mid-section.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, high-contrast, zig-zagging branching line of high-intensity pixels originates at the mid-dorsal ridge and extends ventrally, creating a distinct visual divider between the anterior and posterior texture fields.
